description: This file defines the IGrainContext interface and related extension, within the Orleans runtime, which abstracts the context of a grain, including lifecycle, identity, activation, message handling, and migration.

methods.name: SetComponent
methods.description: Sets a component of a specific type in the grain context.

methods.name: ReceiveMessage
methods.description: Submits an incoming message to this grain instance.

methods.name: Activate
methods.description: Starts activating this grain instance, with optional request context and cancellation support.

methods.name: Deactivate
methods.description: Initiates deactivation of the grain with a specified reason.

methods.name: Rehydrate
methods.description: Rehydrates the grain from a given context.

methods.name: Migrate
methods.description: Attempts to migrate this grain to a new location asynchronously.
